_README: Copy this file to fixtures.local.json, which git ignores, and put your own
leagues in it. `npm run engine:test` then runs the three blocks that need a
real Sleeper league. Without the file those blocks are skipped and every
A league ID is the long run of digits in the league's Sleeper web address.
A draft ID is the one in the draft's address. Both identify real people, so
the file you fill in must stay out of git.

leagues._: Leagues the import check reads. It asserts these exact settings come back.

keeperLeague._: A keeper league with traded picks. The awkward cases live here.

finishedDraft._: A draft that is over, so its numbers never change. Usually last season's draft for keeperLeague.
